ProgramEncoding while Type annotations remain unrestricted. Even templates=[]

sufficient policy. All older laws remain unchanged.

The checked encoded_root_not_origin_policy witness gives an encoded constant
with an unrestricted Type app/4 subtree. The new empty policy holds, while old

gate. Do not identify Library.libraryAvoid with the runtime rewrite catalog.
Do not add reserved-name or Type-grammar restrictions to bypass this gap.

# Actual source pruning admission and policy boundary

Audit completed before additive source work, 2026-11-09 17:37 CET. No old source, Haskell, compiler or Git changes. The new callback-policy module needs no Library/name/Type restriction.

## Actual Haskell selection

`specftacular/src/Specftacular.hs:1233` computes canPrune from absence of ("app",4) in allConstructors of compl_sig's type representations. Utils.hs:148–155 computes that list by recursively visiting the signature types. This is a caller gate, not a universal Type grammar invariant.

At1281–1283, skeleton templates are `filter annotationFree(pruningTemplates...)` only when canPrune AND skeletonTemplates; otherwise []. At1304–1306 the ordinary bucket similarly selects pruningTemplates only when canPrune; otherwise []. `Rewriting.hs:326–362` constructs these from actual rules: linear variables, size bound, application lhs, principal/specialized typing and strict-decrease tests. `rawTemplate` inserts the fixed singleton arrow marker.

`CompiledPruning.preparePruning` (50–68) either returns compiled/reduced graph + residual templates, or falls back to the ORIGINAL graph and FULL template list. Graph/role/cycle/cap/marker failures are real fallback. Compilation success proves exclusions only for eligible templates; it does not turn arbitrary accepted inputs into matches/avoidance or establish recursive cutoff-stream order.

`Pruning.hs:55` uses runsInterned for prunedTerms []. Nonempty templates use the real template oracle. prunedPrograms (95–133) still uses termsPruneUntil at empty catalog, but recordTypes (107–112) skips the oracle then. It retains the actual type metadata, stop and typing callbacks; an empty catalog does NOT disable typing rejection. Keep extend=None, narrow/admits/fits rejection and atTypes stopping distinct.

## Exact Lean mismatch

`SourcePruningEnumerationPolicyOrigins.OriginPolicies` (18–20) unconditionally requires BOTH Avoids templates term AND ProgramEncoding at every ProgramAt of EVERY structural subtree Origin. `Origins.Origin` is an actual atPath, including Type children. `ProgramTypeOriginBoundary.encoded_type_hole_not_program_origin` already gives an encoded constant with an unrestricted Type app/4 subtree. Root encoding alone therefore supplies neither whole-origin encoding nor source Program provenance inside annotations.

Even templates=[] leaves the encoding obligation in OriginPolicies. This is strictly stronger than the actual empty-catalog callback branch. `SourcePruningRecordTypesRefutation.recordTypes_inl_refutes` (37–39) already proves its empty branch using only current pending refutation and literal success_pure; avoids/encoded are unused there. `recordTypes_empty` and recordTypes_inr in SourcePruningRecordTypes (81,87) expose the exact read-free behavior. The new source ProgramSize/Projection certificates intentionally leave Type annotations unrestricted and cannot discharge the blanket policy.

For NONEMPTY arbitrary templates, Avoids cannot follow from FirstOrder source acceptance alone: templates intentionally remove a subset of that language. The semantic target must be accepted AND admitted by the selected pruning catalog, or must derive admission from an actual rewrite-eligibility test. Library.libraryAvoid is a distinct size-two name exclusion mechanism, not this runtime rewrite-template catalog. Do not identify the two.

No Lean runtime selector for Specftacular's canPrune/compl_sig/pruningTemplates gate was found in the inspected policy/driver modules. Generic OriginalFiniteDriver takes arbitrary templates/stop/order/fits/admits. The Specftacular caller's signature and query origin must be modeled before transferring its gate to arbitrary Library/Query data; their constructor catalogs are not already equated.

## Haskell finding and repair: component named filter

This is a VERIFIED implementation defect, not just a static concern. The old
decoder in cfta-generator/src/Data/CFTA/Gen/Synthesis.hs around line 917 matched
application rows with at least two children and filter rows with at least one.
Actual generated Program application rows have EXACTLY four children:
[types, arrow marker, function, argument]. Actual generated filter rows have
EXACTLY two children: [goal, candidates]. Component and query argument rows
have EXACTLY one Type annotation child. All three source type encodings use
the same Program application and filter arities.

Before the repair, a component or argument called filter matched the broad
built-in filter pattern. Its Type annotation was decoded as a Program. The
public reproduction used an exported Library constructor with this input:

    typ = TCons "app" [TCons "A" [], TCons "B" []]
    lib = Library [("filter", typ, ["filter"])] [] [] FirstOrder
    query = Query [] typ
    source component size = 1

The accepted raw witness was filter[app[A,B],filter[app[A,B]]]. Freshly rebuilt
pre-fix public APIs returned solutionsOfSize = [App (Var "A") (Var "B")].
programsOfSize returned cardinality Right 1 and that same value. The decoded
component count was Right [2], although the requested source size was one.
A and B were not library components. The smart library normally renames its
component representatives. That does not restrict the exported constructor.
An ordinary query argument named filter can also reach the unary collision.
Both public roles now have regression checks.

The production repair changes only the two decoder patterns:

    ("app", [_, _, function, argument]) ->
      App (toProgram function) (toProgram argument)
    ("filter", [_, candidates]) -> toProgram candidates

The existing fallback preserves unary component and argument names as Var.
No reserved-name restriction, new dependency or caller premise is added.
The repaired public reproduction returns [Var "filter"], count Right 1,
values Right [Var "filter"] and decoded component counts Right [1].

## Explicit original-data forecast

Let A be GuardUniverse.guards of the ORIGINAL call heap. Let B be the ORIGINAL
algorithmic tuple budget and r the current constructor-heap Fits scalar.
The following functions use finite source data only:

```
s0 = max r (max B 1)
U(s) = Exposure.forecast s (ProjectionResources.jobsBound s s s s)
shape(A,s) = TupleBounds.shapeThrough A s
fresh(A,s) = RowsNumericControl.freshSize A s s
g(A,s) = 1 + max (U(s)) (2*s + shape(A,s) + fresh(A,s) + 2)
M = HeightOrderControlled.majorant (g A) (B+3) s0
P = StepNumericBounds.projectionFuel M
H = StepNumericBounds.readerFuel M
F = g(A,M)
```

P is the common projection ceiling. H is the common recursive reader ceiling.
F bounds the final quantitative profile. The full initial seed is at most F.
The functions are explicit mathematical definitions. The finite guard-shape
functions use classical finite bounds. These bounds can be extremely large.
They are not a practical memory estimate or an execution-time benchmark.
B remains the algorithmic tuple budget. It is not a source term-size request.

The fixed original guard carrier survives actual forcing and sampling.
Actual tuple shape gives raw tuple width equal to sampled operand width.
Rows derive their own normalized classes and exact new handle range. Cached
row length counts duplicate occurrences. Valid handles alone do not bound
that list length. Actual forcing cannot increase captured cell size.
Zero-fit table insertion is counted even when it consumes no tuple budget.

The actual budget above B+2 queue coordinates gives dimension B+3. Each
continuing transition derives a next Frame and a strict vector decrease.
The strict monotone growth function controls the current quantitative
profile. The actual successful Run is derived internally from readiness.
Its induction builds a controlled Path and exact same-state replay.
Path.final_le bounds its last scalar by M. The terminal transition gives F.
The proof compares actual steps at their computed local ceilings. It does
not assume that the computed ceilings exceed an old existential allowance.
Decision completion derives actual table read and table.length+1 growth.
Existing credit extensionality retains that exact decision at larger bounds.

## Biggest remaining gap and next proof work

The principal missing bridge is still an ORIGINAL-request bound on recursive
row visits AFTER narrowing, shared with the complete sparse driver and native
work. A finite Required trie or complete merge bounds one operation. It does
not bound how many new operations recursive reduction and enumeration demand.
Thirty or one hundred outer reduction rounds do not prove one inner pass ends.

Use occurrence-indexed program roles. Components have original leaf rank one;
application rank is the sum of positive child ranks; the filter has rank n+1.
Annotations, marker and goal have Type roles. Do not attach a role only to a
node identity: the same interned record can occur at different positions.

Required paths can expose U in Type positions while Program child ranks
still decrease. This is a source analysis and a next proof plan, not a new
checked generated-role invariant in R129.

budget. EdgeLink's own-field conditions alone are insufficient. Projection
provenance must show that generated kernel intersections are Type/Type.

- BodyEvidence extracts one consistent actual marker, retained arrow, all

  Mu availability and Shape. It does not assume residency of discarded rows.
- BodyWalkReplay derives the COMPLETE actual product, every resident raw
  output row, and ordered All2 replay of every matched pair in the ACTUAL
  final machine. It also derives pure final makeNode replay for those rows.
- RowTransform derives literal stored-substitution children and keys for
  every self row. Each actual self row completes, remains live, and gives
  the exact makeEdge request. It does not assume its recursive result.
- SelfRowSet selects required targets from actual self pairs. It retains
  original source order and multiplicity. Every target belongs to actual
  products, is resident and live, and has literal constructor replay.
- RowNormalization classifies every actual matched output, including both
  arrow/catalog cross directions: dead, or the substitution of a retained
  source row. Catalog duplicates and arrow-name overlaps remain allowed.
  Later sibling states replay the actual original D2 through DomainReplay.
- CanonicalRows uses resident edge-key uniqueness and surviving membership
  to prove literal makeNode request equality. It permits duplicate and dead
  product rows. BodyCanonical derives all its conditions from the actual
  complete product. No normalized-output oracle survives this composition.
- StoredRows uses the actual leaves, encode, input, Scope closed/external
  laws and small list inductions. The checked scheduler correspondence
  transfers to actual FreshOrdinaryStoredSubstitution.execute. It retains
  the final makeNode work instead of assuming that work succeeds.
- BodySubstitution composes the canonical product with that actual stored
  executor. BodySubstitutionInput discharges all conditions from original
  Library/Query data, and derives final SemanticHeap from existing
  execute_scoped applied to the DERIVED execute9 result.
- ProbeChildren proves physical child and makeEdge request composition:
  U->cutoff(U,U), then cutoff(U,U)->probe, equals direct U->probe. It handles
  arbitrary probe references and complete closed marker records. This is
  NOT yet a whole probe callback success or original-U identity theorem.

## How the new execution proof is composed

- BodyRowKinds classifies every retained actual body row as the distinguished
  arrow or an actual rigid/catalog row. It derives all top guards and every
  marker-or-Rec(U) child. Catalog duplicates and arrow-name overlaps remain
  allowed. No residency is assumed for discarded source rows.
- LeafIdentity derives exact resident nullary edge and singleton-node replay.
  The actual leaf walk retains mismatch-edge allocations. Its result is
  Empty or the original resident marker, in both operand orders.
- MarkerIdentity and MarkerReferenceIdentity derive that physical result for
  marker/U at fuel 5 and actual D2 marker/Rec(U) at 7 and its reverse at 8.
  MarkerIdentityInput and MarkerCrossIdentityInput remove all component
  premises at original-Library/Query endpoints.
- CrossRowCompletion runs both actual arrow/catalog cross directions at
  uniform child fuel 8. CrossRowIdentity proves each returned row is dead or
  has the literal arrow self-product key and children. The first child is
  computed by the real request. No result-classification oracle is supplied.
- SecondDomain derives the full actual D2 invariant and the complete extension
  through both real entries. DomainReplay proves D1 and D2 replay after any
  extension of that actual D2 machine. Replaying both entries leaves the
  later domain cache unchanged. The raw-domain successor wrapper is retained.
- ChildCompletion derives all four marker/Rec(U) child combinations at 8
  after preceding sibling effects. RowCompletion runs each actual ordered
  zipped child list and final makeEdge. BodyProductCompletion then runs the
  ENTIRE actual hash-join row list and final makeNode in source order.
  BodyProductInput derives this node execution and actual execute at fuel 9 D2 B/B
  from original Library/Query data. The result is PreparedWithoutMu. Its free
  list is empty or exactly the outer pending (U,U) name.
- InnerMu derives that the different inner (B,U) name is absent. Its optional
  Mu returns the same body and heap without further effects. Actual execute at fuel 11
  in D1 B/Rec(U) therefore finishes with the checked body result. ReferenceOuter
  derives execute at fuel 13 Rec(U)/U as the literal remaining outer construction.
- KernelCoverage proves success-only payload coverage for EVERY bounded actual
  Kernel.execute, with any incoming pending-key allowance. It uses the real
  ordinary constructor and completed optional-binder coverage laws. It makes
  NO coverage claim for a failed pending result, which can retain a reservation.
- ReferenceCompletion applies that coverage law to the DERIVED execute at fuel 9 body
  result. It then applies the actual prepared MaybeMu completion law to the
  outer constructor. Its cold-built corollary derives Facts, availability,
  coverage and SemanticHeap from the actual build. ReferenceInput discharges
  even the cold-built equation from original Library/Query data and derives
  closed output. Returned-U identity is still open.

These equations retain failures where a continuation is not yet discharged.

## Largest gaps and complete target

The next kernel gap is exact output normalization. Marker cross children
are now known to complete and be closed. Their values are not yet identified
as the original marker or Empty. Derive that classification from literal
leaf-row execution, physical Top conjunction and actual resident cache
payloads. It is enough for the next absorption step to show marker-or-Empty:
then each extra arrow/catalog cross row duplicates a self row or disappears.
An iff with catalog membership is not needed for that intermediate argument.
Do not substitute a supplied marker-or-Empty oracle for its proof.

Then prove the complete open body B/B hash join, including special arrow
[marker,R,R] versus catalog ("->",3) in BOTH directions. Prove that the inner
pair(b,u) is absent from output free placeholders. Its optional Mu must be
unused. Prove outer renaming/probe replay hits the original resident U key.
Retained U reuse is still not proved for all inputs, and would not bound
all temporary Mu/probe/ordinary/domain/memo allocations even if proved.

The proposed finite-prefix-over-U class is proved for initial FirstOrder
SYNTAX only. Generated value/native-state preservation remains unproved.
The class grammar itself permits arbitrarily deep ordinary chains, so the
class is not automatically finite. Cached Mu depth is not ordinary term
depth. Native Type.hs75 explicitly distinguishes those quantities. A Mu-depth
bound does not bound prefix structure or total processed work. Derive a
structural bound from original input and preserve it through actual worker
operations. Derive the guard/path/constraint bounds as needed. Do not supply
a finite carrier or validity condition from the caller to bypass this work.

The final resource theorem must derive ONE bound from original input,
request/caller construction and concrete callbacks. Cover BOTH selected-slot
expansion and the complete enumeration driver. Cover every generated,
reached, intermediate, failing, rejected, returned and subsequent state.
Count ALL siblings and all intermediate/native cache allocations. Derive
sufficient recursive depth and total processed work. Do not replace the
required result with successful supplied fuel, a completed worker, finite
carrier, closure/validity/OriginalInput condition, or resource oracle.

Full public API coverage still needs all Sized routes, fallback and failure

lazy sparse storage, productive infinite queries, and native machine/

SourceSynthesisUniverseTopConjunction derives physical source Top conjunction
and its native-edge specialization. Actual allocated equality conjunction
uses the unchanged-state fast path for two live empty payloads. In contrast,
positive Top demand executes intern(some[]) and can allocate on a cold cache.
The exact demand equation retains that boundary. Physical Top equality does
not justify a general zero-allocation assumption.

SourceSynthesisUniverseBodyReferenceControl derives body/Mu identity
separation from actual coherent residency. It continues D1 through lookup
and right-Mu entry into D2. It derives the exact D2 seen alternatives and
body-diagonal freshness, then selects the actual ordinary hash join. There
is no supplied seen/lookup/body-success or numeric-order premise. Native
Node tag1 is less than Mu tag2. Domain pair identities sort NUMERIC IDs
independently: pair(b,u) = pair(u,b), with min/max components.

SourceRecursiveIntersectionLeafNode derives actual leaf-edge and ordered
node-product completion for EITHER operand order. Equal zero arity calls no
children. Arity mismatch builds the actual dead edge. Node normalization
removes those dead rows. The result is closed and its actual optional Mu is
unused. All ordered cache effects remain in the final machine. It does not
identify the result with a particular pre-existing marker record.

SourceSynthesisUniverseRowProducts proves actual repeated-reference cutoff,
ordered catalog children, arity mismatch, closed-marker self including reset,
and arrow self children. It retains literal makeEdge effects. RowKeys,
marker RowReadback and actual diagonal adapters tie those equations to the
computed universe. Full arrow/catalog cross-row normalization remains open.

SourceSynthesisUniverseMarkerCompletion derives empty-domain marker/U
completion and closedness for available actual records. Identity exclusions
and entered-domain freshness come from coherent stored payloads. It handles
both numeric node orders. SourceSynthesisUniverseMarkerInput removes those
internal state premises at its original Library/Query endpoint. Its live-head
lemma retains the first live row through canonicalization without assuming
residency for arbitrary rest rows. Shape yields the actual marker witness.

SourceSynthesisUniverseMarkerReference derives D2 validity, key, free names,
lookup and pair exclusions. The marker/reference child restores U, then its
two closed operands reset to the empty domain. The opposite order performs
the actual initial swap. SourceSynthesisUniverseMarkerCrossInput derives all
inputs and states from original Library/Query and composes both completions.

## Main Sized contract: completed source algorithms

`SizedLanguageTheorem` proves exact distinct accepted terms at every
node-count size, finite reference class evaluation even for infinite
languages, complete size-major prefixes, and both rank/unrank inverse laws.
`SourceSizedTableEvaluation` proves finite count/plan recurrence and
canonical, ordinary-minimum, and product-minimum preprocessing.

The repaired optimized path uses the original sorted explicit rows.
Historical dead-edge and duplicate-edge counterexamples explain why interned
import could change ranks. The repair preserves the interned core.

`SourceSizedFiniteKeys*` now constructs the finite carrier from the actual
validated map keys. The original state type may be infinite. The proofs derive
root/child membership, original row readback, actual dense canonical order,
actual productivity/reachability trim keys, complete bounded table folds,
and relational occurrence traces. They retain the first Unknown and unchanged
exceptions; repeated evaluator replies need not be stable.

Current entry points:

- `SourceSizedFiniteKeysNativeLiquid.encoded_correct`: independent mixed-sort
  ambient logical acceptance, canonical order, complete bounded prefixes,
  distinct size order, and both signed inverses for the actual raw fold.
- `SourceSizedFiniteKeysNativeLiquid.encoded_finite`: finite outcomes from
  finite encoded external attempts, including errors.
- `SourceSizedFiniteKeysDispatch.nativeSized_eq`: exact raw dispatcher equality,
  including all four queries and errors. Raw prechecks and the finite raw
  key-pair synchronous product minimum test are derived.
- `SourceSizedFiniteKeysDispatch.native_success`: successful optimized results
  use the original canonical reference sequence.
- `SourceSizedFiniteKeysRankEvaluation.native_rank_laws`: a finite count inventory
  and finite child maps return the actual optimized public inverse and satisfy
  both signed inverse laws. Counts above the term's node count are not read.

The Sized optimized gate uses explicit synchronous `Language.intersect`.
It does not depend on native interned recursive intersection construction.
See `lean/notes-sized-finite-keys.md`, `lean/notes-source-sized.md`, and
`lean/notes-sized-liquid-probability.md`.
